source: website/data/status.json, written by hand from docs/roadmap.md

items.label: ui-iteration-loop skill
items.detail: Plugin 0.13.1 for Claude Code and Codex: rounds of trial, measure, triage, design decision, build and gate, with hard gates on every merge and ratchets against a baseline.json.

items.label: Marketplace for both hosts
items.detail: Install from a clone of the repository with claude plugin install uxui@uxui or codex plugin add uxui@uxui.

items.label: Plugin check
items.detail: task check validates both manifests and marketplaces and proves the check fails on broken copies of the tree.

items.label: Concept and state spaces
items.detail: The engine, target scopes from component to product, the two spaces, the layout-model contract, bounds and search strategies.

items.label: Metric catalogue
items.detail: 47 metrics: 16 hard rules, 17 KPI candidates, 14 diagnostics, each with a formula, unit, direction and counterweight.

items.label: ESS specification uxsearch v1
items.detail: Eight domains, valid and compiled (254 declarations). 50 authored scenarios cover all 286 refusals of its commands and pass on ESS's interpreted target. No implementation is held to it yet.

items.label: Studio
items.detail: The live view of a search, written as an ess-ui/1 document and generated into an application that runs on fixtures and scripted live events. No engine behind it.

items.label: Ratchet preset family web-ux@1
items.detail: A draft preset family for the metric catalogue, waiting for ratchet's format to settle.

items.label: Specification round 2
items.detail: Done: 50 authored scenarios, every refusal covered. Open: 19 UNMAPPED markers, each listed with its gap or its question to the owner, and an independent review.

items.label: Cost of one evaluation
items.detail: A spike that measures the per-state cost of a layout call. The design assumes 50 µs. The tool ux-search cost is written; its first measurement is still to be made.

items.label: Static metrics slice ux-static@1
items.detail: Static metrics from an ess-ui/1 document, its journeys and its declarations, written as ratchet evidence. No browser, no layout model.

items.label: First climb on a toy
items.detail: Two axes on one example page, searched exhaustively, a ranked frontier printed as text; then the studio. The search ux-search climb is written for theme x section order on layout model v0; it also climbs the studio's live climb page (120 section orders, frontier 42); no UI state exploration. The engine ran its first campaign on the browser adapter over the documentation landing page (144 variants, 864 renders, frontier 16, the page as shipped ranked 35th); a person's pick from that frontier is promoted (density 0.85, the primary action 24 px higher), and the page as shipped ranks 11th, on the frontier. A campaign declared in a file ran on one page of the generated studio and on one list page of an admin console in a private repository (32 variants, 192 renders, frontier 6, the page as shipped ranks 28th).

items.label: Ratchet integration
items.detail: Presets, gates on merge and promote, and the first loop copy moved onto ratchet and uxui.

items.label: The skill on the engine
items.detail: ui-iteration-loop as a thin round on top of the engine: findings become ratchet requirements, taste stays with people.
